units.source_text: 接着，令人惊讶的事情发生了，
就在这时，从谷底刮起一阵风，风中飘来温柔的声音：

en.t: Just then, a gust of wind rose from the bottom of the valley, and a gentle voice drifted in on the wind:

units.source_text: “感谢发长彦君的救命之恩，您的恩德我将永远铭记于心。

en.t: Thank you, Lord Hatsunagahiko, for saving my life; I will remember your kindness in my heart forever.

units.source_text: 我是被土蜘蛛百般凌辱的笠置山的笠公主。

en.t: I am Princess Kasa of Mount Kasagi, who was cruelly humiliated by the earth spiders.
